sentences.text: When a system anomaly appears, the evidence needed to act is rarely in one place.
This representative Mistral workflow brings the investigation into one controlled process.
It retrieves the relevant diagnostics, service history, engineering documentation, and previous cases, while preserving a link to every source.
It compares related incidents, identifies supporting and conflicting evidence, and builds a concise diagnostic brief.
When confidence is limited, it flags the uncertainty instead of guessing.
An engineer reviews the evidence, challenges the recommendation, and approves the next action.
Every step, decision, retry, and approval remains visible and traceable in Mistral Studio.
Let's map one high-value ASML diagnostic workflow and define the pilot.
